topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: Rain's drumming a steady beat against the window, same as my nerves against the inside of my skin. Turner's moving, gone with the wind to some sun-soaked state where the years count less and the questions are lighter. Always thought us two, we'd ride this town out, side by side, in the shadows and the light. Guess that was before the world got its teeth into him. I should have known better. All the times we had, the secrets we kept, they're packing up, too, along with the rest of his life. Didn't see this coming from a mile away, didn’t want to. Now, I'm left here, in this city of ghosts, wondering what part of me he's taking with him.
